annotations.title: Get domain registration Coinbase (USDC) pay link

description:
Get a Coinbase checkout link, paid in USDC, to register a FRESH domain (an available domain that is NOT a curated Atom marketplace listing — for a listing use get_domain_purchase_coinbase_pay_link). The link supports the x402 protocol, so an agent with a crypto wallet (e.g. a Coinbase agentic wallet / x402 client) can pay it directly; a user can also open it in a browser and pay with their own wallet. Use this when the user wants to pay with crypto/USDC, or when an x402-capable wallet is available in this session. term_years is derived server-side from the TLD.

Always present the exact server-computed price returned here (includes VAT where applicable) — never estimate or recompute it yourself. This tool charges nothing by itself.

AFTER PAYMENT: call get_coinbase_payment_status with the returned payment_code — the domain is only registered once that reports status 'completed' (poll again while 'pending'). If the registry rejects the registration after payment it reports 'refunded' (credited to the Atom account balance).

If this reports error 'registrant_contact_required', ask the user for their name, phone, address, city, zip, and country, call create_registrant_contact with those, then retry. If it reports 'billing_country_required', the user must save a billing country on their Atom account first.
